Cut only one third of the blade at a time. The grass stays stronger.
The best height is about 3 inches. Too short burns in the sun.
Sharp blades make a clean cut. Dull blades tear the tips.
Water in the morning. Midday sun wastes water.
If grass grows past 6 inches, the HOA may send a warning.
Mowers miss the fence line. Use a trimmer for the edges.
A reel mower jams if the grass is taller than 5 inches.
Set the deck high enough so you do not scalp the lawn.
Gas mowers stop when the tank is empty. Refuel at the shed.
Oil the engine every 10 mows so it does not run rough.
